description: Paid endpoint ($0.004): 30-day Hyperliquid funding history for the top ~40 perps by open interest (USD), refreshed hourly: current rate, 7d and 30d average (hourly and simple annualized fraction), min/max with time, positive/negative hour counts, and the 5 most positive/negative coins over 7d, plus a live block per coin fetched at call time: mark, funding now (hourly + APR), OI USD, 24h volume, OI change 1h/24h, and predicted next funding on Hyperliquid, Binance and Bybit with the predicted cross-venue APR spread. sort=oi|funding_now|apr_7d|oi_chg_24h|predicted_spread. Compact by default; variant=full (all coins) or coin=["BTC"] (1-10 coins) adds the ~720-row hourly series, same price. For one arbitrary perp over a custom window use get_funding_history. Bad params 400, coin not in set 404, stale 503; no charge on errors. Returns x402 requirements + URL. Free sample: https://cryptofeed402.site/samples/funding-history-panel

coin.description: Optional coins from the set, e.g. ["BTC","ETH"]; returns those coins with hourly series

name: get_funding_history_panel
